standard.summary: 将特定 DiT block 标记为"可重物化"（rematerializable），允许在显存压力下按需放弃这些 block 的激活并在需要时重新计算，比 gradient checkpointing 更灵活。
standard.effect: 在显存充足时缓存激活（快速 backward）；显存紧张时丢弃激活并重算（节省显存），实现自适应显存管理。
standard.whenToUse: 动态显存需求变化较大时（如不同大小图像交替训练），自适应显存管理比固定 checkpoint 更高效。
standard.avoidWhen: 固定分辨率训练时，静态 gradient_checkpointing 通常更简单有效。

standard_en.summary: Marks specific DiT blocks as rematerializable, letting the trainer drop their activations under memory pressure and recompute them on demand -- more flexible than plain gradient checkpointing.
standard_en.effect: Caches activations while VRAM is plentiful (fast backward) and discards then recomputes them when VRAM is tight (saves memory), giving adaptive memory management.
standard_en.whenToUse: When memory demand varies a lot during the run (for instance alternating image sizes), where adaptive management beats a fixed checkpoint policy.
standard_en.avoidWhen: At a fixed resolution, static gradient_checkpointing is usually simpler and just as effective.

advanced.principle: 通过 torch 的 activation recomputation API 标记 block 为 rematerializable，PyTorch 内存管理器在 OOM 风险时自动触发重计算而非直接 OOM。比手动 checkpoint 更细粒度。
advanced.tradeoffs: 自适应重物化的决策时机（何时触发重算）不完全可预测，可能在关键时刻引入额外计算延迟。

advanced_en.principle: Marks blocks as rematerializable via torch's activation recomputation API, so PyTorch's memory manager triggers recomputation automatically under OOM risk instead of OOMing. Finer-grained than manual checkpointing.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The timing of adaptive rematerialization decisions (when recompute fires) is not fully predictable and can add compute latency at critical moments.
